critique.summary: Portrait 1080x1350 testimonial quote card on the branded dark-navy (#111827) artboard. The single focal block — decorative opening quote-mark, 64pt/800 hero quote in three lines, teal accent rule, then attribution — is vertically centered on one clean left spine at x=96. The quote clearly dominates on the squint test, contrast is strong, nothing clips, and the intentional no-image decision is correct for a pure-typographic quote card.
acceptance_notes: A/ALIGNMENT: all five elements share a single left spine at x=96 — the block reads as one intentional left-aligned stack.
B/SPACING: rhythm is coherent — quote_mark above the quote, three lines evenly leaded, accent_rule -> author_name -> author_role tightly grouped and separated from the quote by a deliberate gap.
C/HIERARCHY: squint test passes — the 64pt/800 white quote is the unmistakable focal point; the 96pt quote_mark at opacity 0.64 reads as subordinate; 24pt name / 14pt role visibly secondary.
E/CONTRAST: white quote and 24pt name on #111827 are high-contrast; opacity-0.64 role text and quote_mark remain legible.
G/CLIPPING: quote wraps cleanly to three lines within the right edge; nothing cut off; accent_rule fully on-canvas.
D/WHITESPACE: generous ~65-70% negative space reads as intentional poster/quote-card idiom; block vertically centered.

I/REQUEST+BRAND: matches requested artifact and 1080x1350 dimensions; quote and attribution both prominent; brand tokens consistent with Lumen Platform Default; only environmental LUMB0613/0614 warnings.
J/IMAGERY: no image is correct and on-brief — a photo would be gratuitous.
requirement_coverage_notes: Quote text rendered as the dominant hero element.
Attribution 'Priya N.' and 'VP Brand, Northwind' both present and prominent.
Decorative opening quote-mark glyph present at reduced opacity.
Teal accent rule present separating quote from attribution.
